entry.summary: Suppose $\(X\,cal(M)\,mu\)$ is a measure space. \ Let $ cal(N) := { upright("all null sets in ") cal(M) } $ Claim: $ accent(M, macron) := { E union F divides E in cal(M)\,F subset.eq N upright(" for some ") N in cal(N) } $ is a $sigma$-algebra, 并且在 $accent(cal(M), macron)$ 上存在一个 unique 的 extension $accent(mu, macron)$ of $mu$.

entry.summary: 给定一个 premeasure $mu_0$ on algebra $cal(M)_0$ of $X$, 以及其 induced outer measure $mu *$, 我们令 按 [$sigma$-algebra generated by a subset] 的定义, $ cal(M) := < cal(M)_0 > $ 表示 $sigma$-algebra generated by the algebra $cal(M)_0$. \ 并令 $ mu := mu^(*)\|_(cal(M)) $ then we have: + $\(X\,cal(M)_0\,mu_0\)$ extends to $\(X\,cal(M)\,mu\)$ \ 即: $mu\|_(cal(M)_0)= mu_0$ + $mu\|_(cal(M))$ 是 the largest extension of $mu_0$ to $cal(M)$ (即: 对于任意其他的 $cal(M)$ 上的 measure $nu$ that extends $mu_0$ to $cal(M)$, 都有 $nu\(E\)lt.eq mu\(E\)$ for all $E in cal(M)$); \ 并且 if $mu_0$ is $sigma$-finite, 则 $mu$ 是 the unique extension of $mu_0$ to $cal(M)$.

entry.summary: Any premeasure can induce an outer measure: $ mu^(*)\(E\)= inf { sum_(i = 1)^oo mu_0\(A_i\)divides A_i in cal(A)_0\,E subset.eq union.big_(i = 1)^oo A_i } $ 并且, we have: $ mu^(*)\|_(cal(A)_0)= mu_0 $ 并且 every set in $cal(A)_0$ is $mu^(*)$-measurable.

entry.summary: Let $\(X\,cal(M)\,mu\)$ be a measure space. \ 如果 $mu\(X\)< oo$, 则称 $mu$ 是 finite 的. \ 如果存在一个 sequence $\(E_i\)$ in $cal(M)$ 使得 $union.big_i E_i = X$ 并且每个 $mu\(E_i\)< oo$, 则称 $mu$ 是 $sigma$-finite 的.
